owns: Unambiguous provider-transaction to Forecast-event identity. A match requires an explicit payee alias + mapped Atlas account + direction + an allowed scheduled/posting-date relation, or — for the named fixed Tennis BC salary streams only — a uniquely proven transfer credit into BILLS (chequing-a) that is independently paired to the TENNIS INCOME salary flow + direction + an allowed scheduled/posting-date relation, or — for named youtube-premium, named spotify, named chatgpt-plus-dale, named chatgpt-plus-amanda, and named icloud-storage — schedule-trust-on-due, which represents the occurrence from the schedule itself on or after the due date without a bank transaction. Optional payeeExcludePatterns refuse a hit that also matches a reimbursement or other excluded alias. Same-day is the default; named automatic payments may opt into weekend-to-next-business-day; a payment onto a mapped card may cover the latest due on or before posting. A covers-due-on-or-before-posting match against a once occurrence is allowed only when the posting is on or before seven calendar days after that due; a later same-alias debit does not reuse that once occurrence. Named Fortis, Shaw, Netflix, heloc, bell-sep15-2026, and bell may use covers-early-or-due-on-or-before-posting: after identity, a debit may settle the nearest due within seven calendar days after posting (early pay) or the latest due on or before posting. A nearer prior due still wins over a farther upcoming due when distances tie. Named Triangle and MBNA card-minimum rules may instead use covers-statement-cycle-or-latest-due: after identity, a payment on or after that card's debts.statementCloseDay may settle the upcoming minimum that statement created, and a later payment may still cover the latest due on or before posting. Statement close days are not copied into this file. Amount similarity is not identity. After that identity is unique, a card extra payment may settle the min only when the observed credit is at least the scheduled due. Named tdfees uses two-leg-sum: both named MONTHLY ACCOUNT FEE debit legs (chequing-a and chequing-b) must uniquely match the same occurrence before it is represented. One leg is not settlement. Two same-account legs are not that tdfees settlement. Named bell-sep15-2026 opts into same-account split legs on two-leg-sum (sameAccountSplitLegs true): exactly two distinct posted Bell Mobility / BELLMOBILITY debits on canonical chequing-a, the same household posting date, and early-or-due, both resolving only to that once occurrence. Same-account combining is not the default. Two same-account legs without that explicit opt-in are not settlement. The observed sum is settlement evidence after identity, not identity. Named fixed salary streams additionally require the exact scheduled amount as a necessary guard; that amount is not identity by itself. A generic exact-amount BILLS transfer is not salary identity. A TENNIS BC payee credit on a household account is not salary identity. A TENNIS INCOME deposit or reimbursement is not household-cash posting proof. An unrelated household transfer is not salary identity. A refund or merchant credit is not a card-minimum payment. The mapped TD personal, Cash Back, and Travel Visa posted credit alias PAYMENT - THANK YOU is that same card-minimum identity; a payee that also matches a refund or reversal alias is not. A payment before statement creation does not settle that future minimum. Named mapped-MBNA card-credit rules that claim the literal payee payment require payeeMatchMode exact; a PAYMENT-prefixed reversal, refund, or protection alias is not that identity. Fortis, Shaw, Netflix, tdfees, bell-sep15-2026, and bell remain identity-plus-evidence each cycle: matching confirmed-settled transactions create representedActuals and mark PAID; without matching evidence those bills stay still-due / unverified. YouTube Premium, Spotify, ChatGPT Plus Dale, ChatGPT Plus Amanda, and iCloud Storage are the named schedule-trust exceptions. Do not settle chatgpt-plus-amanda from the Dale rule. Do not invent an Apple scrape or Gmail fetch.
does_not_own: Permission to write plan.opening or representedEvents onto data.json, pending-to-posted proof, or a second event engine.
